papers.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
papers.summary: A selective harness-rescue training method uses specialized sibling harnesses to replace failed reinforcement learning rollouts and transfer their benefits into a single policy that performs better under the original base harness.

papers.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
papers.summary: SLA is a spatial-language-action model that continually pre-trains and post-trains a pretrained VLA policy with spatial alignment to a frozen 3D perception model, using feature-dependent gates and probabilistic state dropout to improve spatial understanding across diverse robot data while preserving inference architecture.
